name: Aura of Suffering (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability drain, curse, or energy drain, Cha 13

Benefit(s): You surround yourself with a sphere of power with a radius of 5 feet per Hit Die that negates all forms of fast healing, regeneration, and conjuration (healing) spells and effects.
